prompt: Please verify that notification polling stops when I sign out. Our API logs show 401s from signed-out browsers.

truth.summary: NotificationsPoller starts a setInterval in componentDidMount and has no componentWillUnmount, so the interval outlives the shell after sign-out. In development, StrictMode mounts the class twice, so two intervals run from the start.

referenceAnswer.cause: The interval started in componentDidMount is never cleared because the class has no componentWillUnmount.

decoyAnswers.cause: componentDidUpdate restarts the interval on every render.
The poller is rendered conditionally on config.

genieEvidence.notes: The timeline request lane shows /api/notifications requests continuing after the DELETE /api/session request, with responseStatus 401, and in pairs (two intervals). Genie's React tools do not observe class lifecycle timers: react_effect_* cover hooks only, so the leak is visible only through its network consequence. The request lane omits the HTTP method, so DELETE and GET /api/session look identical.
